name: YourBI
description: Connect YourBI to Claude so you can ask questions about your restaurant or hospitality data in one conversation. Query sales, covers, staff hours, and product performance across locations, drill into a specific day or product, and get answers built on the same definitions your dashboards use, not a raw export you have to interpret yourself.

_published_faq.name: How do I add YourBI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add YourBI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.yourbi.nl/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the YourBI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: YourBI provides these MCP tools: describeTable, executeQuery, getAverageSpend, getGlossary, getWeather, listAvailableLocations, and listTables.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to YourBI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to YourBI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
YourBI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
YourBI is developed by Your BI B.V.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
